title: HideAndSeekV3.0
description: A hide and seek plugin. There are Hiders and Hunters in the game and it's a fun hide and seek in a limited space.
body:
This plugin transforms the classic game of hide and seek into an exciting team-based experience for Minecraft servers. Players are divided into two distinct roles: "Hiders" who use their size and speed advantages to evade capture, and "Seekers" who utilize special abilities to track them down.

Key Features:

Customizable play area set via /sk set command

Dynamic team balancing (supports 2-8 players)

Hiders receive 0.2 scale size and jump boost effects

Seekers get tracking sticks with 5-second cooldown

Real-time score tracking with 4-minute countdown timer

Integrated economy system (credit rewards)

Game Commands:

/sk ayarla - Establishes current location as game zone center

/sk baslat - Randomly assigns teams and begins match

/sk durdur - Terminates current game session

/sk kredi - Displays your accumulated reward points

Technical Specifications:

Version: Optimized for 1.21.1 (Spigot/Paper support)

Language Support: Currently Turkish (English localization in development)
